headline: Sent template administrator and employee contracts back to administration and HR for more collaboration.
summary: Administrators spoke during public comment about proposed contract changes. The chief financial officer reviewed nearly $9.4 million in unbudgeted spending and a projected 1.1M deficit after corrective steps. Options discussed included applying the restricted medical fund, which gives $3M to offset costs, and a soft spending freeze.
decisions: Approved the October 20, 2026 minutes, 5 yes and 2 abstaining.
Sent the template administrator and employee contracts back to administration and HR to allow collaboration with administrators; the motion carried unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to approve: Christina DiPrete Second: Suzette Wordell Yea: Suzette Wordell, Christina DiPrete, Lee Rabbitt, Kimberly Grant, and Joanne Bonollo Abstain: Randy Buck, James Chellel Motion carries.
